asked.item: Why portal won't let them switch from Creator to Starter

verdict.reason: S2, S30 and S31 explain Incomplete and that support must cancel the incomplete subscription before switching from Creator to Starter.

steps.text: Incomplete means Stripe started your subscription but the payment itself never went through, so the subscription is stuck in an incomplete state.
A stale Incomplete subscription blocks plan changes, so if the billing portal won't let you switch from Creator to Starter, contact support to cancel the incomplete subscription first.
